resources.string: Turns Kvaesitso app tags into Quick Search app nicknames, so an app tagged “music” is found by typing “music”. Everything happens offline on backup files; your apps are not modified directly.
Adds tags as nicknames. Never removes anything and never changes Kvaesitso.
Keeps tags and nicknames in sync in both directions, including deletions. Produces backups for both apps.
Two-way sync not started yet. The first run combines both sides and deletes nothing.
Two-way sync is set up. Deletions since the last sync will be applied to the other app.
The next two-way run will start over by combining both sides. Nothing in your apps changes now.
Core %1$s · MIT License · not affiliated with Kvaesitso or Quick Search
%1$s is not installed on this device.
1. Open Kvaesitso and go to Settings → Backup.\n2. Create a backup and save the .kvaesitso file.\n3. Come back here and select that file.

1. Open Quick Search and go to Settings → Backup.
2. Export a backup with “Settings” selected and share it to Launcher Tags Sync (or save the .quicksearch file and select it here).

Keep this export: it is your way back if anything goes wrong.
Tip: you can also send the exported file here with “Share → Launcher Tags Sync”.
%1$s\nApp tags: %2$d on %3$d apps · pages: %4$d · shortcut tags ignored: %5$d
First two-way sync: both sides are combined, nothing is deleted.
Everything is already in sync. Nothing to do.
%1$d new and %2$d extended nicknames, %3$d aliases added.
%1$d app(s) are unknown to the Kvaesitso backup, so their nicknames cannot become tags yet. They are retried next time.
This export looks older than the one used for the previous sync. Please export a fresh backup.
The backups produced last time seem not to have been imported.
This would delete many aliases at once. Please review whether that is intended.
The Quick Search backup was exported without “Settings”, so nicknames would be ignored on import. Export again with Settings selected.
A Quick Search nickname entry has an unexpected format and is not overwritten.
The file is not a supported backup.
The saved sync state is damaged. Reset two-way sync on the home screen.
I did not import them – plan again
I undid those changes on purpose
Save the generated backup(s), e.g. to Downloads. Nothing is imported yet.
No backup needs to be saved.
Quick Search: Settings → Backup → Import, then select the saved .quicksearch file.

Kvaesitso: Settings → Backup → Restore, then select the saved .kvaesitso file.\n\nRestoring replaces all Kvaesitso data with the backup, so do it right away, before changing anything else in Kvaesitso.
Import both backups before the next sync. Otherwise the next sync will notice and ask you.
Nothing to import. You are done.
